prompts.prompt: Rebuild this whiteboard objective landscape to express a GENERAL quadratic f(x)=ax²+bx+c, a>0, with NO numerical examples. Keep neat marker style, blue bowl, orange one-step arrow, green minimum. White background, compact landscape 3:2. Place vertical f(x) axis at far LEFT, horizontal x axis near bottom; the bowl's minimum is at an interior x coordinate x* to the RIGHT of vertical axis and ABOVE horizontal axis. Do not label any origin or any numerical ticks. The blue parabola has green vertex (x*,f(x*)) and orange current point on right branch at x_k. Dotted projections connect both points to horizontal axis. Horizontal labels 'x*' under vertex projection and 'x_k' under current projection with real subscript k. One orange curved arrow, offset next to right branch, points from current point down-left to green vertex. Next to arrow small label 'x_(k+1) = x*' using k+1 as real subscript. Upper left within blank area but not intersecting curve put modest formula 'f(x) = ax² + bx + c', with small 'a > 0' below. No f″ formula necessary. No numbers 0,1,2 or fixed coordinates. No title or framing. All lettering should look like normal 14–16px math body text when image displayed 360 CSS pixels wide. This is a symbolic engineering concept diagram, decision variable x horizontal and objective f(x) vertical, NOT derivative curve. Keep notation correct.
